entities.name: Félix Peña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix Ricardo Peña is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher for the Leones de Yucatán of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago Cubs and Los Angeles Angels, in the KBO League for the Hanwha Eagles, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Uni-President Lions. He made his MLB debut in 2016.
